svg.title: Observed Pokemon sales volume
svg.desc: 4,319,801 observed units and 2,789,457 reported transactions. Priced subset: $22,190,515.34 to $28,277,186.74. Coverage is incomplete; missing prices are gaps, not zero revenue.
svg.text: Item-value bounds: priced subset, not total revenue
Reported quantities, not a count of customer orders
Priced subset only; USD, excluding shipping and tax
Price coverage: 3,952,220 of 4,319,801 observed units (91.5%). Missing price bounds appear as gaps.
Coverage differs across dates. Recent dates can be partial; neither chart is a certified marketplace-wide trend.
Recent daily quantities and dollar value
Dollar bounds cover priced units only. Missing prices are unavailable, not zero. Source-date timezone is unpublished.
A sale and its matching purchase are one trade; bought and sold quantities are not added together.
